description: Add a line item to an order: pass order_id, description and unit_price, and optionally quantity (default 1) and metadata. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

order_id.description: The order: its id, as list_orders shows it.

name: add_order_line
